questions.question: What is the main topic of the passage?
questions.answer: It explains the first truth called the Truth of Opening and shows how the forming of living things points to Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: In this passage, what does “opening” mainly refer to?
questions.answer: It means bringing out many different, well-formed living beings from simple origins.

questions.question: What contrast is made between the source and the results in the Truth of Opening?
questions.answer: A single simple source gives rise to countless different and separate forms.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the spread of this opening of forms?
questions.answer: It says it happens together, everywhere, at once, and through one act.

questions.question: What example from the larger universe is used before speaking about living things on earth?
questions.answer: The passage mentions many beings in the cosmic garden, like flowers, being given ordered forms and unique identities.

questions.question: What example from the earth is given to show an even more wondrous display of this truth?
questions.answer: The many species of living creatures on earth are each given a balanced, decorated, and distinct form.

questions.question: About how many species of animate beings are mentioned?
questions.answer: About four hundred thousand species.

questions.question: What human example from the Qur’anic verses is used to support this truth?
questions.answer: Human beings are formed step by step in their mothers’ wombs.

questions.question: What do the verses emphasize about Allah’s knowledge while forms are being made?
questions.answer: Nothing in the heavens or the earth is hidden from Him.

questions.question: According to the passage, why is the shaping of forms such a strong proof?
questions.answer: Because it shows precise power, wisdom, order, and control in every case.

questions.question: Which fields of study are said to support this conclusion?
questions.answer: Botany and biology.

questions.question: According to the passage, what kind of being alone could carry out this universal work?
questions.answer: Only the One God who is unique, all-powerful, and fully aware of everything.

questions.question: Why does this work rule out many independent makers?
questions.answer: Because the work is universal, connected, and all-embracing, so it requires one complete control rather than divided control.

questions.question: What qualities are said to be necessary for the unfolding of forms?
questions.answer: Wisdom, careful attention, comprehensiveness, and infinite power.

questions.question: How are human and animal forms described when they are brought into existence?
questions.answer: They are made separately, in balance, clearly distinct, and in an orderly way.

questions.question: What kinds of flaws does the passage say are absent from this process?
questions.answer: There is no error, no confusion, and no mistake.

questions.question: How does the passage connect comprehensiveness to tawhid?
questions.answer: It says true all-encompassing control itself points to unity and leaves no place for partners with Allah.

questions.question: What final conclusion does the traveller reach before moving on?
questions.answer: The universal forming of all living beings is a very powerful proof of Allah’s unity.

questions.question: What is the “First Truth” named in the passage?
questions.answer: It is called the Truth of Opening.

questions.question: What does this truth teach about the origin of living forms?
questions.answer: It teaches that countless different forms come from one simple source by Allah’s act.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the timing of this act?
questions.answer: It presents it as happening instantly and universally.

questions.question: What does the mention of one deed suggest about the Creator?
questions.answer: It suggests complete power and control without needing helpers.

questions.question: What image is used for the universe when speaking about created beings?
questions.answer: The universe is pictured like a garden filled with many forms.

questions.question: What does each being receive through this divine opening?
questions.answer: Each receives an ordered shape and its own distinct identity.

questions.question: How are the species on earth described as evidence?
questions.answer: They are many in number, yet each is formed beautifully, proportionately, and differently.

questions.question: What lesson is drawn from the verses about the womb?
questions.answer: Even hidden human development is fully controlled and shaped by Allah.

questions.question: Why is the womb example especially meaningful for this argument?
questions.answer: It shows that even in concealed places, creation happens with perfect planning and knowledge.

questions.question: What do the quoted verses say about Allah’s power over form?
questions.answer: They show that He gives form however He wills.

questions.question: According to the passage, what makes the formation of bodies a miracle?
questions.answer: Their form is produced with exact order, wisdom, and distinction in every case.

questions.question: How does scientific study support the argument in the passage?
questions.answer: Deep study of plant and animal life shows such broad and detailed artistry that it cannot belong to many separate causes.

questions.question: Why is infinite power said to be necessary here?
questions.answer: Because the work includes all times, all places, and endless varieties of beings.

questions.question: Why does the passage say this power belongs only to the One who runs the whole cosmos?
questions.answer: Because only the ruler of the entire universe could maintain such complete and connected control.

questions.question: What inference can be made from the repeated order found in all living forms?
questions.answer: The same Maker is acting everywhere with the same wisdom and power.

questions.question: How does the passage use the phrase about embracing all things?
questions.answer: It uses it to show that universal control is itself a sign of divine unity.

questions.question: What relationship does the passage make between Allah’s existence and His unity?
questions.answer: It says the signs that point to His existence also point to His oneness because they are universal and comprehensive.

questions.question: What overall message should a student take from this passage?
questions.answer: The detailed and universal shaping of life is not random or shared among many powers; it points clearly to Allah alone.

questions.question: What truth does the traveller witness in this stopping-place?
questions.answer: He witnesses the Truth of Opening.

questions.question: What is meant by forms being produced from a single simple substance?
questions.answer: It means many different living structures come from a basic shared origin rather than from separate creators.

questions.question: Why is variety important in the argument of the passage?
questions.answer: Because producing endless variety with order and beauty shows higher wisdom and power.

questions.question: How does the passage join unity and diversity together?
questions.answer: It says one act from one Creator produces many different beings.

questions.question: What example from nature helps readers picture this idea?
questions.answer: Flowers in a garden are used as an example of many forms being brought out beautifully.

questions.question: What additional point is made about living species on earth?
questions.answer: Their forms are even more astonishing in their balance, decoration, and uniqueness.

questions.question: What do the Qur’anic references add to the argument?
questions.answer: They provide revealed support that Allah forms human beings knowingly and intentionally.

questions.question: What are the “three darknesses” connected to?
questions.answer: They are connected to human development in the womb.

questions.question: What does hidden creation in the womb show about Allah?
questions.answer: It shows His knowledge, power, and control even where human eyes cannot see.

questions.question: What does the passage say is the strongest proof of divine unity in this discussion?
questions.answer: The bringing forth and shaping of forms.

questions.question: Why does the passage not fully expand every detail here?
questions.answer: Because it says this subject has already been explained elsewhere and only a shorter treatment is given here.

questions.question: Which two sciences are named as witnesses to this truth?
questions.answer: Botany and biology.

questions.question: What conclusion do those sciences support according to the passage?
questions.answer: That no one but the one unique and all-powerful Creator could perform such a universal work.

questions.question: What kind of qualities must be present in the making of forms?
questions.answer: Ongoing wisdom, exact care, broad reach, and boundless power.

questions.question: Why would multiple creators lead to problems, according to the logic of the passage?
questions.answer: Because the flawless harmony and total comprehensiveness of the work leave no room for divided authority.

questions.question: How are all human and animal forms across the earth said to be produced?
questions.answer: With the same power, the same wisdom, and the same artistry.

questions.question: What does the lack of confusion in creation suggest?
questions.answer: It suggests one perfect will and one managing power behind all of it.

questions.question: What is the final proof drawn from comprehensiveness?
questions.answer: Since the work covers everything in a unified way, it testifies to Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What central claim does the passage make about the forming of living things?
questions.answer: It claims that this forming is one of the clearest signs of Allah’s unity.

questions.question: Why is the word “opening” a fitting title for this truth?
questions.answer: Because it describes life and form being brought out from hidden or simple beginnings.

questions.question: What does the passage say happens through the manifestation of the Name of Opener?
questions.answer: Countless different beings receive their own forms and identities.

questions.question: How is the universe portrayed to help explain this point?
questions.answer: It is portrayed as a garden full of created forms.

questions.question: How is the earth portrayed in relation to animate beings?
questions.answer: It is described as a garden containing vast numbers of living species.

questions.question: What special features are emphasized in the forms of living creatures?
questions.answer: They are balanced, ornamented, and clearly distinguished from one another.

questions.question: What human life process is used as direct evidence from revelation?
questions.answer: The shaping of people in the womb.

questions.question: What do the verses show about Allah’s authority?
questions.answer: They show that rule and creative control belong to Him alone.

questions.question: What do the verses show about Allah’s freedom in creation?
questions.answer: He gives form according to His will.

questions.question: Why is the hiddenness of the womb significant in this argument?
questions.answer: It shows that even unseen creation is perfectly known and directed by Allah.

questions.question: According to the passage, what kind of research supports this truth?
questions.answer: Serious scientific study in plant and animal life.

questions.question: What do botany and biology reveal in this context?
questions.answer: They reveal a level of artistry and total scope that cannot be explained by lesser causes.

questions.question: What three mental qualities are especially required for this deed besides power?
questions.answer: Wisdom, careful attention, and comprehensiveness.

questions.question: Why must the needed power be infinite?
questions.answer: Because the work includes unlimited varieties and constant activity across the whole world.

questions.question: Where alone can such power be found, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Only in the unique Being who directs the entire cosmos.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the production of forms across the earth?
questions.answer: It says they are made with precision and order, without mix-up or failure.

questions.question: What theological conclusion is drawn from all-embracing control?
questions.answer: That true universal control is itself a mark of divine unity and rejects shirk.

questions.question: How does the passage end this section?
questions.answer: It closes by affirming that these comprehensive signs witness both to Allah’s existence and especially to His oneness.

questions.question: What is being proven through the Truth of Opening?
questions.answer: Allah’s unity is being proven through the way forms are created.

questions.question: What does the passage say comes from a simple single source?
questions.answer: Innumerable varied and separate forms come from it.

questions.question: What does the phrase about one act imply about creation?
questions.answer: It implies that creation is under one command and one power.

questions.question: How does the passage compare the cosmos and the earth?
questions.answer: Both are described like gardens filled with many created forms.

questions.question: What is one result of the Name of Opener in the cosmos?
questions.answer: Beings are given arranged forms and individual identities.

questions.question: What is one result of the same name on earth?
questions.answer: Every living species is given its own beautiful and distinct form.

questions.question: Why is the number of species important in the passage?
questions.answer: It shows the huge scale of creation while still preserving order and uniqueness.

questions.question: What do the Qur’anic verses teach about human creation?
questions.answer: Humans are formed step by step in the womb by Allah’s will.

questions.question: What do the verses teach about Allah’s knowledge?
questions.answer: Everything is fully known to Him, whether hidden or visible.

questions.question: According to the passage, why is this process called a remarkable miracle of power?
questions.answer: Because such exact and repeated formation cannot come from weakness, accident, or many conflicting causes.

questions.question: Which subjects of science are brought in as supporting witnesses?
questions.answer: The study of plants and the study of living organisms.

questions.question: What do those studies show according to the passage?
questions.answer: They show a vast, detailed, and artistic pattern in life that points to one Creator.

questions.question: Why can no limited being perform this deed?
questions.answer: Because the deed requires awareness and control over everything at all times.

questions.question: What is said about the forms of men and animals all over the earth?
questions.answer: They are produced by the same power, wisdom, and artistry.

questions.question: What does the absence of error tell us?
questions.answer: It tells us the work is governed by perfect knowledge and deliberate order.

questions.question: How does comprehensiveness function as an argument against shirk?
questions.answer: If one power truly surrounds and manages all things, there is no place for partners to share that rule.

questions.question: What broader connection is made with earlier truths?
questions.answer: The signs that prove Allah’s existence also support His unity because they are universal in reach.

questions.question: If a student had to sum up the passage in one sentence, what would be a good summary?
questions.answer: The flawless shaping of countless living forms across the world shows that their Maker is one, all-knowing, and all-powerful.

questions.question: What section title is given at the start of the target passage?
questions.answer: The section is titled the First Truth: the Truth of Opening.

questions.question: In simple words, what is the “opening of forms”?
questions.answer: It is the bringing out of many kinds of living shapes and identities from simple beginnings.

questions.question: What four ideas about this opening are stated together near the start?
questions.answer: It is countless, varied, widespread, and accomplished in a single moment by one act.

questions.question: How does the passage show that this truth is visible in both the cosmos and the earth?
questions.answer: It first speaks about beings in the cosmic garden and then about living species in the earthly garden.

questions.question: What is said about the identity of each created being?
questions.answer: Each one receives its own distinct character and form.

questions.question: What adjectives are used in meaning to describe the forms of animate species on earth?
questions.answer: They are balanced, adorned, and clearly different from one another.

questions.question: What hidden place of creation is highlighted in the Qur’anic verses?
questions.answer: The mothers’ wombs.

questions.question: What does creation in a hidden place teach about Allah’s attributes?
questions.answer: It teaches His complete knowledge, power, wisdom, and will.

questions.question: What challenge to belief is answered by this example of creation?
questions.answer: It answers the idea that complex life could come about without one fully knowing and powerful Creator.

questions.question: Why does the passage call the opening of forms one of the strongest proofs of unity?
questions.answer: Because it joins immense variety with complete order under one control.

questions.question: Why are readers referred elsewhere for further detail?
questions.answer: Because the topic has already been discussed at length in other parts of the work.

questions.question: What do botany and biology testify to in this passage?
questions.answer: They testify that the unfolding of living forms involves deep artistry and wide-ranging order.

questions.question: What kind of being cannot undertake this deed, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Any being other than the one unique, all-powerful, all-seeing Creator cannot do it.

questions.question: Why is “seeing and doing all things in all things” important here?
questions.answer: Because the work of creation reaches every creature and every place in a connected way.

questions.question: What makes the formation of humans and animals a “most powerful proof”?
questions.answer: They are all shaped across the earth in a precise and consistent way by the same wisdom and power.

questions.question: What does the phrase about no room for partners mean in this section?
questions.answer: It means the total and universal nature of creation rules out any shared divinity.

questions.question: How does the passage connect comprehensiveness with witnessing?
questions.answer: The broad reach of these signs makes them testify not only that Allah exists but that He is one.

questions.question: What transition happens at the very end of the target passage?
questions.answer: The traveller finishes seeing this first truth and then notices the second truth in the same stopping-place.
